svg.aria-label: Three paired live junction feedback experiments
svg.text: Junctions feeding back into live local flow
Accepted seam → delayed conserved packet → local threshold / question → acknowledged response → next queue
Connected experiment on the left; changed seam or seed on the right. No measured samples or numeric carrier state.
